dogecoin.text:
Hearing the $DOGE as a currency argument a lot lately because more and more places accept it as payment. 

Do these people realize they are creating a taxable event for themselves every time they “spend” their #dogecoin? 

Cause in the US it’s a capital asset, not a currency.

$DOGE is down about 50% since Coinbase listed it and over 70% off its highs.

And retail investors seem to have no clue that this could be the future of $SHIB too.  

Or their greed refusing to acknowledge this possibility.
